settings.tab_content: Natural clay is alkaline in nature. When cooking, it interacts with the acidity in food, neutralizing pH levels and making meals significantly easier to digest.
Each vessel is slowly sun-dried for 48 hours, polished using smooth river stones, and fired in open-air wood kilns at 850°C for exceptional structural integrity.
Cure before first use: submerge vessel in water for 24 hours, dry completely, rub inner surface with organic cooking oil, and heat slowly on a low stove.
Crafted using 100% natural, deep-earth riverbed clay. Certified free of lead, cadmium, heavy metals, chemical glazes, or synthetic binders.
